newsitem.title: UK: London's IPE oil exchange appoints compliance exec.
newsitem.headline: London's IPE oil exchange appoints compliance exec.

text.p: London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) on Wednesday announced the appointment of an executive to take charge of a new compliance and finance division at the exchange.
The IPE said it had appointed John Mackeonis as Executive Vice President in charge of compliance.
Mackeonis comes from Britain's Securities and Investment Board where he was in charge of the supervision of derivatives exchanges and of the London Clearing House (LCH).
He was involved in the recent London Metal Exchange (LME) review and the inquiry into the Barings failure.

His appointment follows an IPE inquiry launched in December into delivery against expiry of the IPE's November 1996 gas oil contract after a tussle between two of Europe's biggest gas oil trading houses.
IPE Chief Executive Lynton Jones said the appointment "reinforces the IPE's strong commitment to compliance issues."
Mackeonis will take over from Chief Executive Lynton Jones the running of compliance, internal audit and finance functions.
